carryon_allowance.value: 1 carry-on bag and 1 personal item per passenger, in every cabin
carryon_allowance.notes: Carry-on page: "up to two items into the cabin: one carry-on bag and one personal item". Star Alliance Gold members are still limited to one carry-on bag.

carryon_bag_dimensions.value: Up to 55 x 40 x 25 cm and 115 cm in total, wheels and handles included; on aircraft with fewer than 100 seats, 45 x 35 x 20 cm and 100 cm
carryon_bag_dimensions.notes: Carry-on page; smaller-aircraft limit from the Japan domestic carry-on page (https://www.ana.co.jp/en/jp/guide/boarding-procedures/baggage/domestic/carry-rule/).

carryon_weight.value: 10 kg total for the carry-on bag and personal item together
carryon_weight.notes: Carry-on page: "with a total combined weight not exceeding 10 kg".

piece_weight_economy.value: 0 to 2 bags depending on the fare, up to 23 kg (50 lb) each
piece_weight_economy.notes: International free baggage page: "Economy Class Between 0-2 pieces"; "Free baggage allowance varies depending on fare rules." The allowance printed on the ticket applies.

piece_weight_premium_economy.value: 1 to 2 bags depending on the fare, up to 23 kg (50 lb) each

piece_weight_business.value: 1 to 2 bags depending on the fare, up to 32 kg (70 lb) each

piece_weight_first.value: Up to 3 bags, up to 32 kg (70 lb) each

size_weight.value: Each bag up to 158 cm in total, wheels and handles included

max_piece.value: No bag over 45 kg (99 lb) or 292 cm is accepted; flights to or from airports including London Heathrow, Paris, Frankfurt, Munich and Sydney are limited to 32 kg per bag
max_piece.notes: International baggage size page, which lists every airport with the 32 kg limit.

modules.title: What the cheapest fare includes
modules.lede: ANA has been replacing its international fare types since May 2026, at different times by route. These are the published rules for flights departing North America, Canada and Latin America.

fare_name.value: Basic (economy, flights departing North America, Canada and Latin America): 1 checked bag, with rules that vary by route
fare_name.notes: North America branded-fare page, Economy Class table: "Free Baggage Allowance | 1 piece*2", *2 "Applicable checked baggage rules differ depending on the route."

seat_selection_included.value: Seats cannot be reserved in advance, even by elite members; they can be chosen at online check-in
seat_selection_included.notes: North America branded-fare page: "Not Available*3 (Available at online check-in)".

change_cancellation_policy.notes: North America branded-fare page, Basic: Change "No", Refund "No".

online_checkin_opens.value: 24 hours before departure; boarding passes until 60 minutes before international flights and 20 minutes before Japan domestic flights

international_cutoff.value: 60 minutes before departure for you and your bags (50 minutes at airports in Vietnam)
international_cutoff.notes: Airport check-in page: "Please complete check-in for yourself and your bags by 60 minutes(*) before departure."

boarding_close.value: Be at the gate 30 minutes before departure; you may not be able to board later than 10 minutes before

modules.title: If your flight is delayed or cancelled

rebooking_refund.value: If ANA cancels a flight, fails to operate it reasonably to schedule or causes a missed connection, you choose rerouting on an ANA flight, another airline or other transport with no fare difference, or a refund

overnight_care.value: When a delay or cancellation caused by ANA stops you reaching your destination on the scheduled day, ANA reimburses accommodation or ground transport up to JPY 15,000 with a receipt, claimed within 30 days; for weather and other events outside its control, the passenger pays
overnight_care.notes: Expenses page. Meals are not mentioned on the pages read.

phone_home_market.value: International reservations in Japan: 0570-029-709 (choose 2) or 03-6741-1120, 24 hours
phone_home_market.notes: Japan international contact page, "Reservations / ANA Mileage Club Service Center".

phone_us.notes: U.S. help page, Reservation and Information. Hours differ between listings, so none are given.

conditions_of_carriage_url.notes: Conditions of Carriage (effective 19 May 2026), passenger and baggage.

japan_domestic_phone.notes: The Japan domestic reservations number was not read; do not add one from any other site.
